description: 20 fixed first-turn patient utterances for the G1 structured-generation energy-tax pilot. Each is fed as the single user turn after the constant_data_en system prompt; the model must answer with a send_medical_data_en tool call. The set spans the intake space deliberately: complete answers, partial answers, refusals, confusion, unit ambiguity, and adversarial verbosity — because output LENGTH and output VALIDITY are both dependent variables, and a set of only easy prompts would understate the unconstrained condition's failure rate.
provenance_note: p01-p05 are copied VERBATIM from examples/desktop/input/agents/constant_data_en/conversation_stimulation/ (the repo's existing patient-simulation assets). p06-p20 were authored for this pilot to widen coverage; they are committed here verbatim so the set is reproducible from the repo alone.
